Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    LookUp(Users, ID = currentUserID).FirstName = ThisItem.Name,Color.AntiqueWhite, Color.Orange)

If(
    LookUp(Users, ID = currentUserID).FirstName = ThisItem.Name,
    Parent.Width * 0.55,
    Parent.Width * 0.01
)

If(
    LookUp(Users, ID = currentUserID).FirstName = ThisItem.Name,
    Parent.Width * 0.95,
    Parent.Width * 0.01 +510
)

If(
    LookUp(Users, ID = currentUserID).FirstName = ThisItem.Name,
    Parent.Width * 0.55,
    Parent.Width * 0.01
)

Switch(
    ThisItem.UserType.Value,
    "Duty Officer",   RGBA(179, 199, 57, 1),  
    "Volunteer",    RGBA(255, 165, 0, 1),   // soft yellow
    RGBA(200, 200, 200, 1)             // fallback
)

If(
    LookUp(Users, ID = currentUserID).UserType.Value = "Duty Officer",
    "Hours Worked: " & Text(ThisItem.HoursWorked, "0.0")
)
"This channel is for emergency coordination only. For life-threatening emergencies, call 000."
